From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 19:10:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - ZenHealth

Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and helpful context on ZenHealth's flow and compliance needs. Per our call, we’ll kick off the vendor security questionnaire so your security and procurement teams can review controls and evidence.

Next steps I’m proposing:
- I’ve attached a SIG intake spreadsheet (zenhealth_SIG_intake_v1.xlsx) that contains the vendor questionnaire + a short mapping tab for any evidence files. Can you confirm who on your side will own completing the spreadsheet?
- If it’s helpful, Marissa (cc’d) will coordinate logistics and share any additional backup docs (SOC2 summary, architecture diagrams).
- Target: return the completed intake within 7 business days so we can triage requests and identify any open items quickly. If your security team prefers the SIG or the CAIQ export, let us know and we’ll provide the preferred format.

A few clarifying questions from our security team to help prioritize evidence:
1) Do you require an executed BAA / HIPAA flow-down for any PHI?
2) Are there specific data residency or EU data-transfer requirements (GDPR) we should be aware of?
3) Which specific controls are highest priority (encryption at rest/in transit, SIEM/forwarding of logs, vulnerability scanning cadence, third-party subprocessor list)?

Attachments: zenhealth_SIG_intake_v1.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up once we have the intake back to propose a deliverable timeline.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Hi Camila —

Thanks for sending. Tom and I will take the intake and loop in security. A couple quick clarifications from our procurement/security side before we start:

- Do you prefer we complete the SIG matrix or would you accept a SOC 2 report (we sometimes triage off SOC2 + a control narrative)?
- For HIPAA, we will almost certainly require a BAA if we send any PHI through Redwood. Can you confirm whether Redwood executes BAAs and what the standard process/timing looks like?
- Who should our security team contact if they want to run a short 30-minute follow-up with Rishi or another engineer? Please provide an email.

We should have the intake back early next week.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Program Manager, Security & Compliance 
ZenHealth
alyssa@zenhealth.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - ZenHealth

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the note. Quick answers to your bullets: 

- SOC 2 vs SIG: We can accept either. If SOC 2 is sufficient for your gating criteria we can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (attested 2025) and a short control narrative. If you need the full SIG matrix completed, we’ll work from the intake spreadsheet Camila sent and return the CAIQ/SIG export.
- BAA/HIPAA: Yes, Redwood executes BAAs for customers processing PHI. We have a standard BAA flow; draft can typically be provided within 2 business days and turnaround depends on counterparty review — we’ve seen signatures within 1–3 weeks for most customers. If you anticipate PHI in scope, flag that on the intake so we prioritize the BAA.
- Point of contact for technical/security: security@redwood.ai (this inbox is monitored by our security leadership and infra engineering). I’m happy to join a 30-minute sync — propose Tue/Thu mornings PST next week; let Camila know what works.

I’ve also attached a short SOC2 summary for quick reference (redwood_soc2_2025_summary.pdf).

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_soc2_2025_summary.pdf

Summary / next steps:

- Alyssa/Tom: please flag PHI scope on the intake if you expect PHI — we’ll prioritise BAA draft.
- Rishi: thanks — please expect the intake and any follow-up questions; Alyssa may request a 30-min follow-up for technical controls.
- Marissa: can you add this to our internal HubSpot record and create a checklist for evidence collection (SOC2, architecture diagram, SAAS data flow)? HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890
